questions.question: Ravi, Manish and Naveen alone can complete a work in 30 days, 15 days and 10 days respectively. They start the work together but Ravi leaves the work after 2 days of the starting of the work and Manish leaves the work after 3 days more. In how many days Naveen will complete the remaining work?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Ravi can complete the work 30 days

Manish can complete it in 15 days

And Naveen can complete it in 10 days

**Concept: **

In this type of question always imagine the total work as LCM of time taken by individuals to

perform the work.

**Formula used: **

Efficiency = Total work/Time taken

**Calculation: **

Let the total work be LCM of 30, 15, 10 i.e. 30 unit

So efficiency of Ravi = 30/30 = 1 unit/day

Efficiency of Manish = 30/15 = 2 unit/day

Efficiency of Naveen = 30/10 = 3 unit/day

Ravi work for 2 days and performed work = 2 × 1 = 2 unit

Manish work for 5 days and performed work = 5 × 2 = 10 unit

Naveen 5 day work = 5 × 3 = 15 unit

Remaining work = 30 – (2 + 10 + 15) = 3 unit

∴ Time taken by Naveen to complete the remaining work = 3/3 = 1 da

questions.question: If A is 25% less than B, then what will be the value of (2B - A)/A ?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

A = 75% of B

**Calculation: **

A = 3/4 of B

⇒ A/B = 3/4

Let the value of A be 3x and B be 4x

So (2B – A)/A = (2 × 4x – 3x)/3x

⇒ (2B – A)/A = 5x/3x

∴ (2B – A)/A = 5/3

**Short Trick:**

Ratio of A : B = 3 : 4

∴ (2B – A)/A = (8 – 3) /3 = 5/3

questions.question: Puneet goes to his office at the speed of 60 km/hour and returns to his home at the speed of 90 km/hr. What will be the average speed of Puneet for the whole journey?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Speed of Puneet from his home to office = 60 km/hour

And speed of Punnet from his office to home = 90 km/hour

**Formula used: **

Average speed = 2v₁ × v₂/(v₁ + v₂) 

Where v₁ and v₂ are the speeds of journey for equal distance

**Calculation: **

Average speed = 2 × 60 × 90/(60 + 90) = 2 × 5400/150

∴ Average speed = 72 km/hour

questions.question: A sum becomes 6 times of itself in 4 years at compound interest (interest is compounded annually). In how many years will the sum becomes 216 times of itself?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Amount (A) = 6 × Principal (P)

Time = 4 years

**Formula used: **

A = P (1 + r/100)T

Where A = Amount

P = Principal

r = rate of interest

T = Times

**Calculation: **

Let the principal be P and after T years it becomes 216 times of itself

According to question,

6P = P × (1 + r/100)⁴

⇒ 6 = (1 + r/100)⁴

⇒ (1 + r/100) = 6¹/⁴ ---- (i)

Also 216P = P × (1 + r/100)T

⇒ 216 = (6¹/⁴)T

⇒ 6³ = 6T/⁴

⇒ T/4 = 3

⇒ T = 12 years

**∴ The sum becomes 216 times of itself in 12 years.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** 

A certain sum at C.I become ‘y’ times in n₁ years. and ‘z’ times in n₂ years. then y¹/n₁ = z¹/n₂

Using the above formulae, we have

⇒ 6¹/⁴ = 216¹/n₂

⇒ 6¹/⁴ = 6³/n₂

⇒ 1/4 = 3/n₂

⇒ n₂ = 12 years.

**∴ The sum becomes 216 times of itself in 12 years.**

questions.question: Height of the right circular cylinder is 16 cm. If the diameter of its base is 3.5 cm, then what will be the volume of the cylinder?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Height of circular cylinder = 16 cm

Diameter of base = 3.5 cm

**Formula used: **

Volume of cylinder = πR²H

Where R is the radius of the base and H is height of right circular cylinder

**Calculation: **

Volume of cylinder = π × (3.5/2)² × 16

⇒ (22/7) × 35 × 35 × (16/400)

⇒ 14 × 11 = 154 cm³
**∴ The Volume of the cylinder = 154 cm³**

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 10640 gives interest of Rs. 3724 in x years at 5% simple interest. What will be the value of x?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Principal = Rs. 10640

Simple interest = Rs.3724

Rate = 5%

**Formula used: **

Simple interest (SI) = Principal (P) × Rate (r) × Time (x)/100

SI = (P × r × x)/100

Where x is in years

**Calculation : **

3724 = 10640 × 5 × (x)/100

⇒ x = 7448/1064

∴ x = 7 years

questions.question: A alone can make a chair in 40 days and B alone can make the same chair in 24 days. If A and B are working on alternate days and A works on the first day, then in how many days will the chair be completed?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

A can make the chair in days = 40

B can make the same chair in days = 24

**Concept: **

In this type of question always imagine the total work as LCM of time taken by individuals to perform the work.

**Formula used: **

Efficiency = Total work/Time taken

**Calculation: **

Let the total work be LCM of 40, 24 i.e. 120 unit

Efficiency of A = 120/40 = 3 unit/day

Efficiency of B = 120/24 = 5 unit/day

If they work on alternate days starting from A their 2 days work

= 3 + 5 = 8 unit

i.e. 8 units of work completed in 2 days

So, (8 × 15) = 120 units of work be completed in (2 × 15) = 30 days

**∴ The chair will be completed in = 30 days**

questions.question: Piyush is running at the speed of 8 km/hour and he stops for 5 minutes to take rest at the end of every third km. What will be the time taken by Piyush to cover a distance of 56 km?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Speed of Piyush = 8 km/hour

Takes rest for 5 min at the end of third km

**Calculation: **

In 56 km he will stop for times = 56/3 = 18.67

That means he will stop for 18 times

Total rest time = 18 × 5 = 90 min = 1 hour 30 min

And time taken to complete journey without rest = 56/8 = 7 hours

∴ Time taken by Piyush to complete the journey = 7 + (1 hour + 30 min) = 8 hour 30 min

questions.question: After giving a discount of 20%, a shopkeeper earns 36% profit. Marked price is what percent more than the cost price?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Discount = 20%

Profit = 36%

**Formula used: **

Cost price : Marked Price = (100 – Discount percentage) : (100 + Profit percentage)

**Calculation: **

Cost price : Marked price = (100 – 20) : (100 + 36) = 80 : 136 = 10 : 17

Let the cost price be 10x and marked price be 17x

Difference between marked price and cost price = 7x

∴ Percentage from which MP is greater than CP = (7x/10x) × 100 = 70%

**ALTERNATE SOLUTION: **

Let the ratio between MP and SP be after 20% discount = 5 : 4

Ratio between CP and SP after 36% profit = 50 : 68

⇒ SP must be same in both transaction so, new ratio of MP to CP = 85 : 50

∴ Percentage from which MP is greater than CP = [(85 – 50)/50] × 100 = 70%

questions.question: The average of six numbers N₁, N₂, N₃, N₄, N₅, and N₆ is A. 5 is subtracted from each number. What is the new average?
questions.solution:
**Concept: **

If the average of n numbers is N and x is subtracted from each numbers then the new average will

be (N – x)

And if the average of n numbers is N and x is added to each numbers then the new average will be

(N + x)

**Formula used: **

Average = Sum of all numbers/Total numbers

**Calculation: **

According to question,

A = (N₁ + N₂ + N₃ + N₄ + N₅ + N₆)/6

⇒ 6A = N₁ + N₂ + N₃ + N₄ + N₅ + N₆

If 5 is subtracted from each number then

New average = (N₁ – 5 + N₂ – 5 + N₃ – 5 + N₄ – 5 + N₅ – 5 + N₆ – 5)/6

⇒ New average = (N₁ + N₂ + N₃ + N₄ + N₅ + N₆ – 30)/6

∴ New average = (6A – 30)/6 = A – 5

questions.question: The Least Common Multiple and Highest Common Factor of two numbers are 60 and 4 respectively. If their sum is 32, then what will be the difference of these two numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given****: **

LCM = 60

HCF = 4

Sum of numbers = 32

**Formula used: **

Product of two numbers = LCM × HCF

**Calculation: **

Let the two numbers be x and y

So,

xy = LCM × HCF = 60 × 4 = 240 --- (1)

x + y = 32 ---(2)

We know that,

(x – y)² = (x + y)² – 4xy

⇒ (x – y)² = 32² – 4 × 240

⇒ (x – y)² = 1024 – 960

⇒ (x – y)² = 64

⇒ x – y = 8

**∴ Difference of these two numbers = 8**

questions.question: The perimeter of a square and a circle are the same. If the area of the circle is 2464 cm², then what will be the area of the square?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Area of circle = 2464 cm²

**Formula used: **

Perimeter of circle = 2πR

Area of circle = πR²

Perimeter of square = 4a

Area of square = a²

Where ‘a’ is the side of the square and ‘R’ is the radius of the circle

**Calculation: **

According to the question,

Perimeter of square = Perimeter of circle

⇒ 4a = 2πR

⇒ a = πR/2

And πR² = 2464

Area of square = a² = π²R²/4

⇒ π × (πR2/4)

⇒ (22/7) × (2464/4)

⇒ (22/7) × 616

⇒ 88 × 22 = 1936 cm2

**∴ The area of square = 1936 cm²**
